an10.41:1.1: athakho āyasmā upāli yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā upāli bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an10.41:1.2: ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yena saṃghe bhaṇḍanakalahaviggahavivādā uppajjanti bhikkhū na phāsu viharantīti.
an10.41:1.3: idhupāli bhikkhū adhammaṃ dhammoti dīpenti dhammaṃ adhammoti dīpenti avinayaṃ vinayoti dīpenti vinayaṃ avinayoti dīpenti abhāsitaṃ alapitaṃ tathāgatena bhāsitaṃ lapitaṃ tathāgatenāti dīpenti bhāsitaṃ lapitaṃ tathāgatena abhāsitaṃ alapitaṃ tathāgatenāti dīpenti anāciṇṇaṃ tathāgatena āciṇṇaṃ tathāgatenāti dīpenti āciṇṇaṃ tathāgatena anāciṇṇaṃ tathāgatenāti dīpenti appaññattaṃ tathāgatena paññattaṃ tathāgatenāti dīpenti paññattaṃ tathāgatena appaññattaṃ tathāgatenāti dīpenti
an10.41:1.4: ayaṃ kho upāli hetu ayaṃ paccayo yena saṃghe bhaṇḍanakalahaviggahavivādā uppajjanti bhikkhū na phāsu viharantīti.
